_about: Single source of truth for timing. animation.py (cameras, events, captions, titles) and tools/voiceover.py read this file. Times are seconds from the start of the video at 30 fps.

lines.text: Imagine an entire village being overcome by an invisible cloud... without anyone knowing what was happening.
lines.tts: Imagine an entire village being overcome by an invisible cloud, without anyone knowing what was happening.

lines.text: This is Lake Nyos, in northwest Cameroon: a calm crater lake on an old volcano.
lines.tts: This is Lake Nyos, in northwest Cameroon: a calm crater lake on an old volcano.

lines.text: But two hundred metres down, it was hiding something.
lines.tts: But two hundred metres down, it was hiding something.

lines.text: Carbon dioxide from magma seeped into its cold bottom water.
lines.tts: Carbon dioxide from magma seeped into its cold bottom water.

lines.text: The weight of the lake kept it dissolved, like a sealed bottle of soda.
lines.tts: The weight of the lake kept it dissolved, like a sealed bottle of soda.

lines.text: Then, on the night of August 21st, 1986, the lake overturned... and the gas burst free.
lines.tts: Then, on the night of August the twenty-first, nineteen eighty-six, the lake overturned... and the gas burst free.

lines.text: A cloud of carbon dioxide, heavier than air, spilled over the rim and down the valleys.
lines.tts: A cloud of carbon dioxide, heavier than air, spilled over the rim and down the valleys.

lines.text: It pushed the oxygen away. In the villages below, people rapidly lost consciousness. Many never woke up.
lines.tts: It pushed the oxygen away. In the villages below, people rapidly lost consciousness. Many never woke up.

lines.text: About 1,746 people died, along with thousands of animals.
lines.tts: About seventeen hundred and forty-six people died, along with thousands of animals.

lines.text: Scientists called it a limnic eruption. Today, pipes vent the gas from the deep.
lines.tts: Scientists called it a limnic eruption. Today, pipes vent the gas from the deep.

lines.text: The most terrifying part? The danger was completely invisible.
lines.tts: The most terrifying part? The danger was completely invisible.
